authority: preregistered fixed-Hc response falsification for immutable E09 exact-aggregate pair

parent_pair_authority.exactness_semantics: numeric equality under the deterministic binary64 aggregate reconstruction used by the preregistered E09 selector

scientific_question: At identical fixed H_c and canonical time, for an immutable pair with exactly equal E09-reconstructed W_profile and W_root30 but materially different H16, is the next forcing-free whole-window bottom exchange unique?

probe_reconstruction_consistency.rationale: The exact-rung authority is the E09 deterministic binary64 reconstruction. The Fortran probe independently re-sums the same vectors in a different operation order; its 1e-12 checks are consistency gates, not a redefinition of exactness.

execution_contract: extract origins only from persisted E09 result vectors
verify the parent E09 pair has exact numeric equality of canonical reconstructed W_profile and W_root30 before compiling or executing the response probe
reseed A and B independently at canonical t0=0
apply only the unchanged E04/E06/E08 forcing-free fixed-Hc response forcing; E09 qssdi/qdra terms are absent
run A then B and B then A with fresh committed origins and fresh backends
strict Reference sample only; one physical advance; no commit, retry, fallback or automatic temporal subdivision
discard every candidate and require committed-origin bit identity
require same-origin bit-identical response across order
require complete mass accounting and |residual|<=1e-12 cm
require byte-identical complete observable output under O0 and O2
interpretation_boundary: Support means that, within the represented binary64 C01 state and the frozen one-window experiment, H_c plus the two exact E09 aggregate storage coordinates are not sufficient to determine a unique next interface exchange.
This is stronger than the earlier tolerance-bounded E04/E06/E08 results but remains a result for the qualified carrier, discretization and finite response window.
Support does not establish H16 as the unique or minimal omitted state coordinate.
It is not a mathematical continuum proof and does not imply production reduced-state admission.
controls: no state or response threshold change
